region: Sunamganj Sadar, Chhatak and Dowarabazar upazilas, Sunamganj District, Bangladesh
event: May-July 2022 Sylhet division flood (UNOSAT event code FL20220525BGD)

sources.name: Sentinel-1 GRD
sources.used_for: Flood extent on each acquisition date (primary flood source)
sources.license: Copernicus Sentinel data, free and open (Copernicus data policy)

processing.dry_reference: median of 2022-02-01 to 2022-03-31, same relative orbit where available
processing.threshold: Otsu on the date's VV histogram (60 m sample); fallback -18 dB when Otsu falls outside -26..-12 dB
processing.change_rule: flooded only if at least 3 dB darker than the dry reference (excludes permanent water)
processing.coverage: pixels outside the swath stay unknown

sources.name: NASADEM
sources.used_for: Slope mask that removes radar-shadow false positives in the Sentinel-1 flood map

sources.name: GPM IMERG Final Run V07
sources.used_for: Daily rainfall over Sunamganj and the upstream Meghalaya hills, shown in the app

processing.aggregation: box mean, Bangladesh local days (UTC+6), mm/day

sources.name: MODIS Terra surface reflectance MOD09GA v6.1
sources.used_for: Optical flood-water proxy, tested; excluded from road cutting because 87-100% of the study area was cloud-masked on every date

processing.rule: NDWI (bands 4 and 2) > 0.15 where the Feb-Mar 2022 baseline NDWI <= 0.15; state_1km cloud mask

sources.name: WorldPop Global Project Population 100 m, 2020
sources.identifier: WorldPop/GP/100m/pop, country BGD, year 2020 (Google Earth Engine)
sources.used_for: Population of each village catchment (Voronoi cell clipped to the study area)

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.identifier: OSM via osmnx (network_type='all'); upazila boundaries via osmnx geocoding
sources.used_for: Road network (21,542 junctions, 24,947 segments), 16 village/town points, 50 shelter candidates, study-area boundary

processing.note: Shelter candidates are unverified OSM schools, clinics and offices

sources.name: UNOSAT flood analyses, event FL20220525BGD
sources.used_for: Independent reference for the flood-extent benchmark only; never used to build SafeWindow maps
